scene.language: This scenario is modeling an overlap in soccer. (click) [0][1] The coach moves to a position where there-- the coach moves forward to a position to find his o- to create space, with the hopes to attract the defender towards him. [2][3][4](click) The coach receives the ball, but note the defender's very close to the coach. So the coach passes back to the teammate, as there's no space to dribble forward. [5](click)[6]
